rows.en:
(And this Ozma-san, Ranka-chan's brother,
seems to dote on her a whole lot too...)

(I hope I can become good friends
with Ranka-chan too.)
I wonder when my Galaxy Ramen will be coming?

Aaah! I'm so sorry!
Just a moment, please,
\p-chan!!

(Hee hee, Ranka-chan really is an energetic girl.
She's never boring to watch...)
(I kind of get why everyone likes Ranka-chan.)
\p-kun, be sure to come back again~!

(Nyan-Nyan's maguro buns were amazing,
just like I expected.)
(Okay, what should I do now...)
Hey! You over there!

Yeah, you.
Shut up and come with me a sec.
(I-is this a shakedown...?)

Ozma, you're being way too scary with a kid.
Look, you've got the poor boy trembling.
rows.notes: ??? plate; the next rows show it is Bobby. Bobby's camp voice.

rows.en: Tch, getting scared over something like this...
(Huh?! Ozma... Could he be...?)

I've got no intention of hurting you.
I just have some business with you,
as Ranka's big brother...
Oh, so you really are Ranka's big brother.

That's right. I'm Ranka's beloved big brother,
Ozma Lee.

And I'm the love of Ozma's life,
Bobby Margot.
Nice to meet you, kiddo.

My name's \p.
So what exactly do you want with me...?

There's something I absolutely
have to tell you...

rows.notes: The two lines of Japanese ellipses kept as ASCII dot lines. Ozma asking the player (direction: request to the listener).

rows.en: Huh? Wha?

What's with you, punk...
You saying you can't be friends with Ranka? Huh?!

O-of course not!
I'd be honored to be her friend!
I see... That's all I needed to hear.

(H-he stopped me in a back alley like this
just to tell me that...?)
But if you ever lay a hand on Ranka...
rows.notes: Male version; the female version (c21456) says 'make Ranka cry' instead.

rows.en: You know what'll happen to you, right?

Good, that'll do.
That's all I wanted to say.
See ya.

Sorry, kiddo.
Just think of today as getting bitten by a dog
and let it go. Hee hee, bye now.
rows.notes: Japanese idiom (bitten by a dog = bad luck you just shrug off) kept literal; Bobby's voice.

rows.en: (Phew, I thought he was going to kill me...)
Are you all right?

Ah, yes...
Wait, who are you?

I am Canaria Berstein,
a colleague of Ozma's.

Sorry about that.
He has a tendency to be a bit overprotective
of his little sister Ranka.
I just experienced that firsthand...

I hold a medical license, you see.
If you get a minor injury, I'll treat it myself.
Huh? You're assuming I'll get hurt someday?

Heh, I'm joking.
If you're still alive, we'll meet again.

(Ozma-san must be a good guy who cares about
his sister, but that's way too overprotective,
no matter how you look at it...)
(I'd better be careful not to get hurt, at least...)
\p-chan, be sure to come back again~!

(Nyan-Nyan's maguro buns were amazing,
just like I expected.)

Ozma, you're being way too scary with a kid.
Look, you've got the poor girl trembling.
rows.notes: ??? plate; Bobby (female variant, ojou-chan = the poor girl).

rows.en:
Oh, so you really are Ranka-chan's
big brother.

And I'm the love of Ozma's life,
Bobby Margot.
Nice to meet you, missy.

My name's \p.
So what exactly do you want with me...?

(H-he stopped me in a back alley like this
just to tell me that...?)
But if you ever make Ranka cry...

Sorry, missy.
Just think of today as getting bitten by a dog
and let it go. Hee hee, bye now.

(Ozma-san must be a good guy who cares about
his sister, but that's way too overprotective,
no matter how you look at it...)

(All right, today's Sports Day!
I'm gonna do my best to shine too!)
Geez, events like this are nothing but a drag...

How can you say that, Alto?!
Not getting fired up for an event this hot...
Are you even a man?!
Hey, Kagura! What did you just say?!
Yuuto, Alto, both of you calm down...

Well, since we're doing it anyway,
winning beats losing. Guess I'll take it
a little seriously.
I've gotta look good in front of Nanase-san too...
Huh? Did you need something from me, Luca-kun?

N-Nanase-san!
N-no! It's nothing at all!!

(This team sure is a mess...
Are we really gonna be okay?)

(Well, whatever happens, happens...
Now, time to start my warm-up stret...)
rows.notes: Interrupted mid-word, as the Japanese trails off.

rows.en:
Whoa, whoa...
At an event as passion-boiling as Sports Day,
aren't you forgetting someone important?
Me, it's me!
Huh... You're...
Wh-who are you...?

Geez, you don't know who I am?
Just how far behind the times are you?
(What am I supposed to say to that...)

Listen... Carve my name into your soul!
My name is Luis Fernando!
A burning man overflowing with passion!!

(...He doesn't look like a Mihoshi teacher...
C-could he be some kind of creep...?)

(Maybe I'd better report this to a teacher
after all...)

What, you heard my name and you still
don't know me? Just how fresh are you...?

But inside that freshness of yours,
I can feel a burning passion...
Hey, kid, what's your name?
M-my name's \p.

\p, huh...
I've carved your name deep into my soul...

Heh, see you around,
Fresh Boy!
Huh? Fresh Boy...?

(Who on earth is this Luis-san guy?
He might even be someone dangerous...)

uncertain: c21419/c21451: speaker plate is '??? (man)' but the line is Bobby's (he introduces himself two rows later); written in Bobby's camp voice.
c21428: Ozma's two lines of Japanese ellipses rendered as two ASCII dot lines (40 dots each); shorten if they look too long in game.
c21437/c21457: Bobby's idiom 'think of it as being bitten by a dog' kept literal (meaning: shrug off bad luck).
c21431: humble 'nakayoku sasete itadakimasu' rendered 'I'd be honored to be her friend!' (shared by both player genders).
